label: GLM Coding Plan Lite
limits: Each plan is subject to both a 5-hour usage limit and a weekly usage limit. Lite: 2,000 5-hour credits, 10,000 weekly credits. 5-hour credits: dynamically refreshed; credit quota resets 5 hours after consumption. Weekly credits: activated upon subscription; resets every 7 days. During off-peak hours, model usage is charged at 50% of the standard credit rate (peak: Mon–Fri 14:00–18:00 UTC+8). Est. 48–104M GLM-5.3 tokens/week depending on cache hit rate.
notes: The $18 monthly price is primary (docs: 'Starting at just 18 USD per month'). The $12.60/mo annual figure is secondary: 30% yearly discount, 20% quarterly ($14.40). z.ai/subscribe renders prices client-side, so it couldn't be scraped. Since 2026-07-30 the plan bills in credits instead of prompts. FAQ: 'strictly limited to use within officially supported tools and products', with a list of about 20 tools including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Third-party use is fine within that list and forbidden outside it. ZCode and AutoClaw consume 1.5x usage. Plan quota can't be used for general API calls; from 2026-10-16 coding-plan API keys are separate keys. No refunds.

label: GLM Coding Plan Pro
limits: Pro: 12,000 5-hour credits, 60,000 weekly credits (same reset and off-peak rules as Lite). Est. 290–627M GLM-5.3 tokens/week.
notes: Credit limits are primary. The $80 price is secondary: the official 2026-04-21 Legacy Plan Migration Notice still shows $72 for the old prompt-based plan, and third parties report the live subscribe page shows $80 for the credit plan. Annual $56/mo is secondary. Supported-tools-only restriction as for Lite.

label: GLM Coding Plan Max
limits: Max: 28,000 5-hour credits, 140,000 weekly credits. Est. 676–1,463M GLM-5.3 tokens/week.
notes: The $168 price is secondary; the legacy prompt plan was $160 per the official migration notice. Credit limits are primary.
